summary: Iteration 167: Verified all data quality sanity checks for candidate profile capture from Chrome Extension. All 27 tests passed (100%). Fixed a bug where `re_module` was not imported at the top of routes/extension.py, causing 500 errors when page_text field was used.

✅ Designation validation working: 'Engineering Manager' KEPT, 'Rate estimation and Capacity mapping' REJECTED

✅ POST /api/extension/ai-extract returns extraction_source='regex_hybrid' for well-structured profiles
✅ All 35 existing regex parser tests (iteration 164) still pass

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 167 verified all data quality sanity checks: 1) CTC capped at ₹20 Cr - project values like 'Rs 30000 Cr' are rejected, 2) Education validation rejects job responsibilities ('Raw material handling', 'Negotiate for best contract') and keeps valid degrees ('MBA/PGDM', 'B.Tech'), 3) Location uses word boundary matching - 'Goal-oriented' does NOT produce 'Goa', 4) Designation validation rejects responsibility text and entries >80 chars, 5) page_text field parsing extracts CTC/notice from structured Naukri page data.
